goals: Verify that the application displays seen network requests and allows users to view their detailed request and response information in a modal.
Verify that users can navigate the cache view to inspect cached request details, delete cached requests, and view stub details.
activities: Execute jambox reset task
Mount the App component
Send a request to the test URL
Send requests to pathA, pathB, and pathC
Locate the request element corresponding to the test URL
Verify the request element contains '200' and 'fetch'
Click the request element
Locate the request info modal
Verify the modal contains the test URL
Click the select response tab
Verify the modal contains 'path' and '/returnThisAsJson'
Click the back to waterfall button
Verify the modal no longer exists
Uncheck the block network checkbox
Verify the block network checkbox has the indeterminate property
Wait for 50 milliseconds
Send another request to the test URL
Click the cache link
Locate and click the cache cell edit element by hash
Click the select request tab
Verify the cache detail contains the test URL, 'path', and '/returnThisAsJson'
Click the back to cache button
Verify the cache detail no longer exists
Click the cache cell edit element again
Click the cache delete button
Verify the cache detail no longer exists
Locate and click the stub cache cell edit element by stub hash
Click the select response tab
Verify the cache detail contains 'test-stub'
